answer: Rather than prove who you are, the network asks what you can still produce, on a seeded orchard that changes every epoch. Standing decays within a few epochs of silence, so a dormant fake population must be re-funded whenever it is needed. That converts its lantern from a permanent asset into a stock of perishable work, held at a recurring cost. Because standing decays, dormant accounts are liabilities rather than assets, so the whisper behaves like a perishable stock instead of a durable balance. Seal 15irh.
